description: This file defines a Java interface 'GroupDao' for data access operations related to 'Group' entities, extending a generic DAO interface and declaring methods for retrieving group information based on permissions and group types.

classes.name: GroupDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for 'Group' entities, providing methods to query groups based on permissions, type, and IDs.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects associated with a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by the specified GroupType.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects matching the specified set of group IDs.
